## 低解像度項目反応モデル


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_1PL <- df[, c("受付番号", "BP", "FLCΣ", paste0("item", 1:18))]
colnames(df_1PL) <- c("id", "BP", "FLCΣ", paste0("item", 1:18))

library(tidyr)

df_1PL_long <- df_1PL %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("item"),
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  )

kable(head(df_1PL_long))
```

## BP の高低と項目反応

### BP の層別


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df$BP_level <- case_when(
  df$BP > 0.9 ~ 3,
  df$BP > 0.6 & df$BP <= 0.9 ~ 2,
  df$BP <= 0.6 ~ 1
)
length(df[df$BP_level == 3, ]$BP)/dim(df)[1]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 0.2945205
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}

```

formula_1PL <- bf(
  活気 ~ 1 + (1 | BP_level)
)

fit_1PL <- brm(
  formula = formula_1PL,
  data = df,
  family = brmsfamily("categorical"),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 5000
)
